hypothesis_confirmed.finding: An ASOF JOIN whose left OR right side is an inline filtered scan of a
billion-row base table fatally crashes the DuckDB 1.4.4 Python binding
('PyEval_SaveThread: the function must be called with the GIL held').
Materialising BOTH sides first is the fix.
hypothesis_confirmed.why_dev_tier_never_saw_it: The dev tables are small dedicated tables, so both
sides of the join were already materialised and local.
This is why T5a passed and predicted 2,271s.
